evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: So I just wanted to let you know that we talked to a lot of people everyday and most of them have one or two concerns either the movers are not showing up on time or damage to their items, or either of those a concern for you.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer responded 'No ma'am, I would need to let them, I would need to let them in' — rep acknowledged with 'On the storage and department. Okay, great' and moved forward without probing deeper into what the customer meant.
evidence_quotes.value_days: No mention of value days, day-of-week pricing options, or date flexibility for savings. Rep moved straight into time-slot negotiation.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: There's no deposit required no risk and securing your spot in case if you wanted to reschedule or to cancel then all you have to do is just simply give us a call at anytime. Would you like me to lock that in for you?

top_strength: Rep successfully gathered comprehensive logistics details (multiple addresses, storage type, floor levels, walking distances, item counts) and delivered both pricing promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage at $2,000), creating a full estimate anchored to the specific move profile.
coaching_note: Step 2 concerns were rushed — the customer's response about needing access was not explored two layers deep; more critically, step 5 skipped the Save Your Ass prep framing entirely and step 6 never happened, so the rep never took a temperature check after pricing or asked what was still concerning the customer before the ask.
